sampling: Raw-logit argmax with fixed output lengths, including EOS
hash_format: SHA-256 of comma-separated ASCII token IDs
timing: Synchronous greedy forwards including cache evaluation. Prefill supplies the untimed first token.

expert_union.capture: Untimed eager FFN forwards on generated tokens, with greedy output checked against stock serial

serial.snippet: - Memory bandwidth limits autoregressive decoding because each generated token requires reading all model weights from memory, and the arithmetic per byte is ti

k_star_rule: Lowest mean of workload median ms per position, exact on every repeat in every workload

paging.scope: Host-wide counters after warmup. Pageins include file I/O and cannot identify GPU-specific paging.
